turns.user: how do I do a deadlift
turns.reply:
Here are the 3 main steps:
1. Feet hip-width, bar over mid-foot. Grip outside your knees.
2. Shins touch bar, chest up, squeeze armpits like crushing oranges to set your lats.
3. Deep breath, brace hard, and push the floor away.



Focus on pushing the floor away instead of pulling with your back to protect your spine and load your glutes and hamstrings.

turns.reply:
Here is your complete guide to the deadlift:

1. Setup — feet hip-width under the bar, bar over mid-foot.
2. Grip — bend at the hips and take a double-overhand grip outside your knees.
3. Position — bring your shins to the bar, lift your chest, and pull your shoulder blades down.
4. Tension — pull the slack out of the bar until you hear a click before you lift.
5. Execution — brace your core, push the floor away with your legs, and stand up tall.
6. Lockout — squeeze your glutes at the top without leaning backward.
7. Lowering — hinge at the hips first, then bend your knees once the bar clears them.



The key is making every rep a sequence of pushing the floor away, not pulling with your lower back.
